Sam — looping in our SRE and security SMEs. A few quick, targeted answers for the questionnaire items you called out: 

- KV cache persistence: by default Redwood retains ephemeral KV caches per-request to avoid persistent sensitive data in inference layer. For customers choosing private or dedicated deployments, we can enable persistent KV with customer-managed encryption keys (CMK) and provide key rotation guidance (AWS KMS/HSM integrations supported).

- Encryption: data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 server-side for hosted deployments; we can provide guidance for customer-managed keys and offer HSM-backed options on Private.

- Audit logs: we can stream inference-level audit events to a customer-owned S3/CloudWatch or push to a syslog endpoint. Retention is configurable — default 90 days on hosted; special SLAs available under Dedicated/Private.

I'll draft answers into the spreadsheet and share the Drive link when done. If you need a short technical session, I can do a 30-minute deep-dive tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
